name: Ongc
about: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Ltd. (ONGC) is India’s leading oil and gas exploration and production company, playing a crucial role in meeting the country’s energy needs. The company’s operations span the exploration, extraction, refining, and distribution of crude oil, natural gas, and petroleum products. ONGC operates both onshore and offshore oilfields and supplies a significant portion of India’s crude oil and natural gas. It also engages in joint ventures and partnerships for energy projects globally. With a strong focus on innovation and sustainability, ONGC contributes to India’s energy security while exploring new opportunities in renewable energy sources.
